tasks.name: data-analysis
tasks.theme: I want to evaluate whether a model can interpret semi-structured data and experimental results, perform operations and analysis, and derive the correct conclusion.

tasks.name: instruction-following
tasks.theme: I want to evaluate whether a model can satisfy multiple instructions and constraints that are simultaneous, compositional, and out-of-distribution when serving as an AI assistant.

tasks.name: long-context
tasks.theme: I want to evaluate whether a model can perform well on long context retrieving and reasoning, finishing long-horizon tasks.

tasks.name: multilingual
tasks.theme: I want to evaluate whether a model can perform understanding, generation, and reasoning tasks across diverse languages including low-resource languages.
